findings.text: `assert fields["time_budget"] == "30m"` compares the output against the same literal the test supplied as the node's budget, so it passes unchanged under the verbatim-copy regression it sits beside; it guards only over-clamping, which the clamp case does not cover.

the executed run-review path calls _review_dispatch_fields without config, so the clamp resolves the project's own flight config while _dispatch_composed_review validates against the caller's config; a caller supplying a divergent config could still compose a budget above the fence validation measures. The manifest already records this under outside_scope.
